Albanese urges middle powers to unite at UN on AI

Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese addressed the United Nations General Assembly, calling for "middle powers" to unite and address the challenges posed by artificial intelligence. He stated that smaller nations must take on the superpowers in the context of AI development and regulation.
